unbounded_semantics.indices: Exact unbounded public-size/index arithmetic and public loop generation; fixed addresses and wiring are free. No finite API, address, allocation or table-exhaustion ceiling is used.
unbounded_semantics.data: Retain 64-bit limbs, data registers, carries and selected native kernel arithmetic; public loop controls are unrolled according to their intended size arithmetic.
unbounded_semantics.table_extension: Explicit mathematical continuation of original tuned power-of-two tail. Not a claim that an existing finite DLL executes astronomical indices.
unbounded_semantics.native_lowering: Each 64-bit ADD/ADC data instruction lowers to64 unsimplified full-adder cells,128AND+192XOR, including constant initial carry and final carry. No cross-instruction CSE, constant folding or gate pruning. Other arithmetic uses correct circuits with nonnegative gate counts.
unbounded_semantics.proof_scope: A chosen optimized-source circuit family; not a lower bound on every equivalent circuit, all tuned GMP variants or physical CPU time.

counting_interface.native_add_n: For each n>0, quotient/remainder control in coreihwl/aors_n.asm covers each input limb exactly once with64-bit ADC. Eight-limb unrolling and software scheduling do not remove additions.
counting_interface.butterfly: Pinned FFT uses separate mpn_add_n/mpn_sub_n. Every butterfly has an unconditional add_n on at least nprime limbs; K=2 basecase uses nprime+1.
counting_interface.node_word_additions: Three transforms times K*k/2 butterflies times nprime; therefore >=3*k*pl, since K*nprime>=2*pl.
counting_interface.node_lower_AND: 6*k*N with N=64pl under specified full-adder lowering.
counting_interface.node_lower_XOR: 9*k*N with N=64pl under specified full-adder lowering.
counting_interface.assembly_preservation: Public SIMD scheduling is not treated as free data arithmetic; selected ADD/ADC circuit semantics are charged. No extrapolation from measured nanoseconds.

termination_scope.unbounded_tail: For pl>2^46, selected/aligned k has sqrt(pl)/2<=2^k<2sqrt(pl), giving initial child<5sqrt(pl). If child>2^32, regular-tail alignment is stable after one rounding and adds<2sqrt(child), since each tail interval endpoint4^j is divisible by2^j. If child<=2^32, the exact pinned selector has k<=17, and each continuing rounding must strictly increase k; total rounding increment<2^18 (including a possible crossing into the first regular-tail interval). Either way final child<6sqrt(pl)<pl.
termination_scope.bounded_prefix: For pl<=2^46 the parameter table is unchanged. Retain standard correctness/termination of these original finite native GMP regimes; this audit is not a complete formal verification of GMP. The explicit added tail has now been covered in full.
